title: Extraction and Selection of High-Molecular-Weight DNA for Long-Read Sequencing from Chlamydomonas reinhardtii
author: Frédéric aux-Jukic

steps.title: Grow Chlamydomonas culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate Chlamydomonas reinhardtii in 100 mL TAP medium, incubate under low light (~5 µmol photons m⁻² s⁻¹) with constant shaking at 100 rpm and 25 °C (or other conditions as required) until exponential phase.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: At ~10⁷ cells mL⁻¹ (end of exponential growth), transfer culture to 50 mL tubes and centrifuge at 4000 × g, room temperature, 5 min; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Store or proceed with pellets
steps.instruction: Optionally store cell pellets at –20 °C; otherwise continue.

steps.title: Thaw pellets and chill
steps.instruction: If frozen, thaw pellets at room temperature, then place on ice.

steps.title: Pellet wash centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4000 × g, 4 °C, 5 min and discard any remaining liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend in pre‑heated CTAB
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet by gentle pipetting in 3 mL CTAB solution pre‑heated to 65 °C; use wide‑bore tips, invert gently, avoid vortexing.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹) and 5 µL RNase A (100 mg mL⁻¹), mix by pipetting, then incubate at 65 °C for 20 min in a water bath.

steps.title: First clarification centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4000 × g, room temperature, 5 min; distribute the supernatant into three 1 mL aliquots in 2 mL tubes (total 3 mL); discard pellet.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: To each tube add 1 mL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), invert 10 times, centrifuge 20000 × g, 4 °C, 5 min; transfer the upper aqueous phase to new 2 mL tubes, avoiding the interface and taking no more than three‑quarters of the aqueous layer.

steps.title: Second proteinase/RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL proteinase K and 1 µL RNase A, invert 3 times, incubate at 50 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Chloroform wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), invert 3 times, centrifuge 20000 × g, 4 °C, 5 min; transfer the upper phase to new 2 mL tubes.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL isopropanol to each tube, invert 10–12 times; a visible DNA precipitate should form (discard if green/brown contaminants co‑precipitate).

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 20000 × g, 4 °C, 5 min; discard supernatant, add 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol without disturbing pellet, centrifuge again at 20000 × g, 4 °C, 5 min.

steps.title: Remove ethanol and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Discard ethanol carefully; either dry the pellet in a SpeedVac at room temperature for 5 min or leave tubes open at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA overnight
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 30 µL ultrapure water and incubate overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: AMPure bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Pool all 30 µL DNA samples from the same culture into one 1.5 mL Lo‑Bind tube; add an equal volume of AMPure XP beads (e.g., 30 µL), mix gently by hand for 5 min; allow beads to reach room temperature, vortex 10 s, and ensure complete mixing with the DNA sample.

steps.title: First magnetic bead separation
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 5 min, discard supernatant, remove tubes, resuspend beads in 60 µL ultrapure water for at least 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second magnetic bead separation
steps.instruction: Return tubes to magnetic rack for 5 min, transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Lo‑Bind tube, discard beads.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a Nanodrop and/or Qubit device.

steps.title: Adjust concentration and add SRE buffer
steps.instruction: Measure input DNA concentration with Qubit (as recommended), dilute each sample to ~150 ng µL⁻¹ in 60 µL ultrapure water, add an equal volume of Short Read Eliminator (SRE) buffer (Circulomics), then centrifuge at 10000 × g, 4 °C, 30 min; carefully pipet off the colorless supernatant.

steps.title: First 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol to the pellet, centrifuge at 10000 × g, 4 °C, 2 min, and discard ethanol.

steps.title: Second 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous ethanol wash step.

steps.title: Final drying and resuspension
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet for 10 min at room temperature, then resuspend in 50 µL pre‑warmed EB buffer (Circulomics SRE kit) and incubate at 50 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Store or sequence DNA
steps.instruction: Proceed to long‑read sequencing or store DNA at 4 °C for several weeks (do not freeze). DNA purity can be re‑checked by Qubit/Nanodrop; absence of small fragments assessed by agarose gel and size distribution by PFGE.
